category_title: Students who seek autonomy and independent mastery
scenario_title: Core academic class with close supervision and abstract relevance
minimal_context: The student is working on a required assignment from their course binder in a traditionally structured core academic classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's open your binder and start on today's core academic assignment. You need to complete all these problems because everything you learn in here you're going to need at some point in your life.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't see the point of this. They focus a lot more on what you're going to use stuff for in electives than they do in core classes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just focus on question number one. I am going to stand right here to make sure you do the work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I could do this if I just had the opportunity to decide where I was heading within certain academic boundaries, and was given the time and space to reach these goals on my own.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just go step-by-step. Write down the first part of the answer right now while I watch.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing this anymore. I can't learn anything with you breathing down my neck.
